```sql
CREATE VIEW open_claims_paid AS
SELECT c.claim_id, p.product_line, COALESCE(pay.total_paid, 0) AS paid_to_date
FROM claims c
JOIN policies p ON p.policy_id = c.policy_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT claim_id, SUM(paid_amount) AS total_paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id) pay ON pay.claim_id = c.claim_id
WHERE c.claim_status = 'OPEN';
```
